2607.12279.title: A Shared Subcircuit Lets LLMs Count Down Across Tasks
2607.12279.paper_summary: Writing a sentence of exactly twelve words; ending a DNA sequence at the right codon; formatting an ASCII table. These are all tasks that language models can do that requires tracking how many tokens remain before a target. In this work, we identify in Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct a general mechanism for performing these tasks: a "countdown subcircuit" that compares the current position to a goal length and estimates the time remaining until then. We first isolate a countdown subcircuit in a controlled setting, in which the model is tasked with writing a fixed-length sentence ending in a specified word. We then investigate the geometry of the representations used by the subcircuit, and find that the subcircuit uses an identical motif previously identified in a frontier LLM on a separate task, thus suggesting that this motif is shared across models. Finally, we use unsupervised probing on a natural language dataset to find a variety of other tasks where this subcircuit is used, including tasks where the goal length is inferred from context rather than explicitly stated. Our work suggests that reverse-engineering subcircuits allows us to understand how behaviors generalize from a single example to many different tasks and even models.
2607.12279.paper_summary_zh: 寫一個正好有十二個單詞的句子；在正確的密碼子處結束一個DNA序列；格式化一個ASCII表。這些都是語言模型可以執行的任務，需要追蹤在目標之前剩餘多少個標記。 在這項工作中，我們在Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct中識別出一種執行這些任務的通用機制：一個“倒計時子電路”，它將當前位置與目標長度進行比較，並估算到達目標所需的剩餘時間。 我們首先在受控環境中孤立出一個倒計時子電路，該模型的任務是寫出一個以指定單詞結尾的固定長度句子。 然後，我們研究子電路所使用的表示的幾何形狀，發現該子電路使用了一個在不同任務的前沿LLM中先前識別的相同主題，從而暗示這一主題在模型之間是共享的。 最後，我們在一個自然語言數據集上使用無監督探測，找到各種其他任務，其中使用了這個子電路，包括那些目標長度是從上下文推斷而非明確陳述的任務。 我們的工作表明，逆向工程子電路使我們能夠理解行為如何從單一示例推廣到許多不同的任務，甚至模型。
